claims.claim_text: Intra-document contradiction across claims [23], [29]
claims.evidence: Layer D reason: Claims 23 and 29 assert that Leukotriene A4 connects to 5,6-epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid, but Leukotriene A4 (C00909, formula C20H31NO3, 4 oxygens) cannot form 5,6-EET (C05356, formula C20H32O3, 3 oxygens) through any standard biochemical transformation. Converting an epoxide to a ketone would add an oxygen, while converting a ketone to an epoxide would remove an oxygen—the oxygen counts and structural arrangements are incompatible for direct interconversion.. Cited claim texts: ["Arachidonic acid is connected to Leukotriene A4 via 5,6-epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid", "Leukotriene A4 connects to 5-HETE via 5,6-epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid"]
